definitions.all_play_win_pct: For each regular-season scoring period, compare a team's score against every other team's score that period. Wins count as 1 and ties count as 0.5.
definitions.expected_wins: Sum of weekly all-play win percentages.
definitions.schedule_luck: Actual W-L equivalent minus expected wins. Ties count as 0.5.
definitions.strength_of_schedule: Opponent scoring metrics from actual regular-season opponents.
definitions.median_plus_win_pct: Weekly record against the league scoring median.
definitions.close_game_5: Games decided by 5.0 points or fewer.
definitions.close_game_10: Games decided by 10.0 points or fewer.
definitions.blowout_20: Games decided by 20.0 points or more.
definitions.blowout_30: Games decided by 30.0 points or more.
definitions.score_std_dev: Sample standard deviation of weekly regular-season scores.
